senses.gloss: ch. (b. h.; √בו or בה, v. בהי, בהל) to run to and fro, be agitated. Part. בָּיֵיךְ, f. בָּיְיכָא.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87">Gen. R. s. 87</cite>, beg. (expl. <he>הומיה וכ׳</he> <cite ref="Proverbs 7:11">Prov. VII, 11</cite>) <he>בייכא היא וטעיא</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="U00248"><he>שגשיא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 940:3">Yalk. Prov. 940</cite> <he>בוכה</he>, corr. acc.) she runs about (revelling) &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:1:14">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Micah 7:4">Mic. VII, 4</cite>) (read:) <he>מן גו דא אנן בָּיְיכִין ובכון וכ׳</he> therefore we are now in trouble. And they wept &c. Ruth. R. s. 3 (before I, 18) <he>קל ברייתא בייבין</he> (read <he>בייכין</he>) the sound of people runing in excitement (on business).
